Package index

Predicted means and comparisons

Means of factor terms with their standard errors, intervals and pairwise comparisons; contrasts, joint tests and slopes.

predictmeans()
Predicted Means of a Linear Model
covariatemeans()
Predicted Means of a Linear Model with Covariate Variable(s)
contrastmeans()
Linear Contrast Tests for a Linear Model
specify_contrast()
Contrasts Written with Level Names
contrast_family()
Families of Contrasts among Means
pm_joint()
Joint F Tests of Contrasts among Means (Slices)
pm_slopes()
Slopes of a Covariate by Group
Kmatrix()
Matrix of Coefficients in a Linear Model

Results and plots

Stable tables (tidy, as.data.frame), plots drawn from results, and the advice kept with every result.

tidy(<predictmeans>) glance(<predictmeans>) as.data.frame(<predictmeans>) coef(<predictmeans>) vcov(<predictmeans>)
Predicted Means and Pairwise Comparisons as Data Frames
tidy(<pm_curves>) as.data.frame(<pm_curves>) print(<pm_curves>)
Curves and Their Differences as Data Frames
autoplot(<predictmeans>) plot(<predictmeans>) summary(<predictmeans>) print(<summary.predictmeans>)
Plots and Summary of Predicted Means
autoplot(<pm_curves>)
Plots of Curves, Surfaces and Their Differences
PMplot()
Level Plot of a Matrix of p-values
advice()
Advice on a Result

varcomp()
